tools.name: get_drive_weather
tools.description: Arrival-time weather between named places, defaulting to departure now. Planned departures use local time at the origin within ten days. Missing or ambiguous places return clarification. Includes data credits and a link to the drive in Windshield Weather. Returns text and structured data without a c

tools.name: get_drive_weather_interactive
tools.description: Arrival-time weather between named places, defaulting to departure now. Planned departures use local time at the origin within ten days. Missing or ambiguous places return clarification. Includes data credits and a link to the drive in Windshield Weather. Returns text and structured data with an int

tools.name: get_highway_weather
tools.description: Read the current published forecast for a supported highway, optionally scoped to a state, province or town. Includes now, 3, 6, 12 and 24 hour readings and official road-condition service links. This does not report road closures. Returns text and structured data without a card, suitable for schedu

tools.name: get_highway_weather_interactive
tools.description: Read the current published forecast for a supported highway, optionally scoped to a state, province or town. Includes now, 3, 6, 12 and 24 hour readings and official road-condition service links. This does not report road closures. Returns text and structured data with an interactive forecast card.
